cases.name: Erica Christine Evans-Jimenez
cases.about: “She just was a really truly beautiful soul,” said Rikki Deal, a good friend of Evans-Jimenez.
cases.narrative: On 4/30/2022, her body was found in a secluded area called Bird Creek in Tulsa County.
